newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Oil suspends Albanian operations.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Oil suspends Albanian operations.

text.p: Fountain Oil Inc said Wednesday that as a result of the current political turmoil in Albania, it suspended activities related to the Gorisht-Kocul field in the country's southwest region.

Fountain Oil and Albpetrol, the Albanian national oil company, each has a fifty percent interest in a joint venture to rehabilitate and develop the Gorisht-Kocul field, for which Fountain Oil acts as operator, the company said.
The suspension will remain in effect until conditions permit the safe and efficient transportation of equipment and personnel to the location and safe operating conditions resume, the company said.

The joint venture had previously awarded a drilling contract for the drilling of two wells in the Gorisht-Kocul field and the contractor was ready to ship the equipment, Fountain said. The contractor has now suspended the mobilization, Fountain said.
Fountain Oil said it declared the political unrest in Albania to be a force majeure and notified Albpetrol and the Albanian National Petroleum Agency of this.

During the period in which force majeure is in effect, obligations under the Joint Venture Agreement and the Petroleum Development and Production License for the Gorisht-Kocul field are suspended, Fountain said.
